name: Innervate
description: Infuse a friendly healer with energy, allowing them to cast spells without spending mana for 8 sec.

name: Tranquility
description: Heals all allies within 40 yards for 19,417 over 5.4 sec.\n\nHealing decreased beyond 5 targets.

name: Heart of the Wild
description:
Perform a powerful off-role ability depending on your currently active shapeshift form.

Non-shapeshifted:
Empowered Wild Growth that heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for 6,514 over 7 sec.

Bear Form:
Increase your maximum health by 30% for 20 sec.

name: Stampeding Roar
description: Shift into Bear Form and let loose a wild roar, increasing the movement speed of all friendly players within 15 yards by 60% for 8 sec.

name: Ironbark
description: The target's skin becomes as tough as Ironwood, reducing damage taken by 20% for 12 sec.

name: Nature's Swiftness
description: Your next Regrowth, Rebirth, or Entangling Roots is instant, free, castable in all forms, and heals for an additional 60%.

name: Maim
description:
Finishing move that causes Physical damage and stuns the target. Damage and duration increased per combo point:

   1 point  : 5 damage, 1 sec
   2 points: 10 damage, 2 sec
   3 points: 15 damage, 3 sec
   4 points: 20 damage, 4 sec
   5 points: 26 damage, 5 sec

name: Typhoon
description: Blasts targets within 15 yards in front of you with a violent Typhoon, knocking them back and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 6 sec. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Starsurge
description: Launch a surge of stellar energies at the target, dealing 796 Astral damage.

name: Wild Growth
description: Heals up to 5 injured allies within 30 yards of the target for 1,085 over 7 sec. Healing starts high and declines over the duration.

name: Frenzied Regeneration
description: Heals you for 32% health over 3 sec.

name: Ironfur
description: Increases armor by 124 for 7 sec.

name: Efflorescence
description: Grows a healing blossom at the target location, restoring 227 health to three injured allies within 10 yards every 1.8 sec for 30 sec. Limit 1.

name: Hibernate
description: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

name: Lifebloom
description: Heals the target for 1,715 over 15 sec. When Lifebloom expires, is dispelled, or is refreshed near expiration the target is instantly healed for 829.\n\nMay be active on one target at a time.

name: Moonkin Form
description: Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing the damage of your spells by 10% and your armor by 125%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Rake
description: Rake the target for 10 Bleed damage and an additional 57 Bleed damage over 15 sec.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Rejuvenation
description: Heals the target for 1,672 over 12 sec.

name: Rip
description:
Finishing move that causes Bleed damage over time. Lasts longer per combo point.

   1 point  : 8 over 1 sec
   2 points: 12 over 2 sec
   3 points: 16 over 3 sec
   4 points: 20 over 3 sec
   5 points: 24 over 4 sec

name: Starfire
description: Call down a burst of energy, causing 360 Arcane damage to the target, and 126 Arcane damage to all other enemies within 5 yards. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Sunfire
description: A quick beam of solar light burns the enemy for 82 Nature damage and then an additional 705 Nature damage over 18 sec.

name: Swiftmend
description: Consume a Regrowth, Wild Growth, or Rejuvenation effect to instantly heal an ally for 3,860.

name: Swipe
description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting Physical damage. Damage varies by shapeshift form.

name: Symbiotic Relationship
description: Form a bond with an ally. Your self-healing also heals your bonded ally for 10% of the amount healed. Your healing to your bonded ally also heals you for 8% of the amount healed.

name: Incarnation: Tree of Life
description: Shapeshift into the Tree of Life, increasing healing done by 10%, increasing armor by 120%, and granting protection from Polymorph effects. Functionality of Rejuvenation, Wild Growth, Regrowth, Entangling Roots, and Wrath is enhanced.\n\nLasts 30 sec. You may shapeshift in and out of this form for its duration.

name: Convoke the Spirits
description: Call upon the spirits for an eruption of energy, channeling a rapid flurry of 16 Druid spells and abilities over 4 sec.\n\nYou will cast Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Moonfire, Wrath, Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Rake, and Thrash on appropriate nearby targets, favoring your current shapeshift form.

name: Mighty Bash
description: Invokes the spirit of Ursoc to stun the target for 4 sec. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Ursol's Vortex
description: Conjures a vortex of wind for 10 sec at the destination, reducing the movement speed of all enemies within 8 yards by 50%. The first time an enemy attempts to leave the vortex, winds will pull that enemy back to its center. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Tiger Dash
description: Shift into Cat Form and increase your movement speed by 200%, reducing gradually over 5 sec.

name: Incapacitating Roar
description: Shift into Bear Form and invoke the spirit of Ursol to let loose a deafening roar, incapacitating all enemies within 10 yards for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Mass Entanglement
description: Roots the target and all enemies within 12 yards in place for 10 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. Usable in all shapeshift forms.

name: Wild Charge
description: Fly to a nearby ally's position.

name: Soothe
description: Soothes the target, dispelling all enrage effects.

name: Cyclone
description: Tosses the enemy target into the air, disorienting them but making them invulnerable for up to 5 sec. Only one target can be affected by your Cyclone at a time.

name: Rebirth
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 100% health and at least 20% mana. Castable in combat.

name: Dash
description: Shift into Cat Form and increase your movement speed by 60% while in Cat Form for 10 sec.

name: Essence of G'Hanir
description: Release the natural power within G'Hanir to increase the frequency that all of your heal over time effects heal allies by 100% for 8 sec.

name: Ashamane's Frenzy
description: Unleash Ashamane's Frenzy, clawing your target 15 times over 3 sec for 27 Physical damage and an additional 81 Bleed damage over 6 sec.\n\nAwards 3 combo points.

name: Barkskin
description: Your skin becomes as tough as bark, reducing all damage you take by 20% and preventing damage from delaying your spellcasts. Lasts 8 sec.\n\nUsable while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared, or asleep, and in all shapeshift forms.

name: Dreamwalk
description: Teleports the caster to the Emerald Dreamway.\n\nCasting Dreamwalk again while in the Emerald Dreamway will return you back to near your departure point.

name: Charm Woodland Creature
description: Allows the Druid to befriend an ambient creature, which will follow the Druid for 1 hour.

name: Growl
description: Taunts the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Remove Corruption
description: Nullifies corrupting effects on the friendly target, removing all Curse and Poison effects.

name: Prowl
description: Allows the Druid to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode.  Lasts until cancelled.

name: Thrash
description: Strikes all nearby enemies, dealing 33 Bleed damage and an additional 12 Bleed damage over 15 sec. When applied from Bear Form, this effect can stack up to 3 times.\n\nGenerates 5 Rage.

name: Strength of the Wild
description: Maul the target for 8% of the target's maximum health in Physical damage.

name: Track Beasts
description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap.

name: Track Humanoids
description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.

name: Bear Form
description: Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing armor by 220% and Stamina by 25%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and increasing threat generation.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Cat Form
description: Shapeshift into Cat Form, increasing auto-attack damage by 40%, movement speed by 30%, granting protection from Polymorph effects, and reducing falling damage.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Cenarion Ward
description: Heals the target for 504.3 every 1.8 sec for 8 sec.

name: Clearcasting
description: Your healing over time from Lifebloom has a 4% chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Regrowth cost no mana.

name: Entangling Roots
description: Roots the target in place for 30 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Ferocious Bite
description:
Finishing move that causes Physical damage per combo point and consumes up to 25 additional Energy to increase damage by up to 100%.

   1 point  : 9 damage
   2 points: 19 damage
   3 points: 28 damage
   4 points: 37 damage
   5 points: 45 damage

name: Flap
description: You flap your wings, slowing your falling speed.

name: Flight Form
description: Shapeshift into flight form, increasing movement speed and allowing you to fly. Cannot use in combat. \n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees the caster of movement impairing effects.

name: Mangle
description: Mangle the target for 70 Physical damage.\n\nGenerates 12 Rage.

name: Mark of the Wild
description: Infuse a friendly target with the power of the wild, increasing their Versatility by 3% for 60 minutes.\n\nIf target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

name: Moonfire
description: A quick beam of lunar light burns the enemy for 80 Arcane damage and then an additional 705 Arcane damage over 18 sec.

name: Mount Form
description: Shapeshift into a mountable ground travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only usable outdoors.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees the caster of movement impairing effects.

name: Nature's Cure
description: Cures harmful effects on the friendly target, removing all Magic effects.

name: Regrowth
description: Heals a friendly target for 1,996 and another 287 over 6 sec.

name: Revitalize
description: Returns all dead party members to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Not castable in combat.

name: Revive
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Not castable in combat.

name: Shred
description: Shred the target, causing 75 Physical damage to the target.\n\nAwards 1 combo point.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Teleport: Moonglade
description: Teleport to the Moonglade.\n\nCasting Teleport: Moonglade while in Moonglade will return you back to near your departure point.

name: Travel Form
description: Shapeshift into a travel form appropriate to your current location, increasing movement speed on land, in water, or in the air, and granting protection from Polymorph effects.\n\nThe act of shapeshifting frees you from movement impairing effects.

name: Treant Form
description: Shapeshift into Treant Form.

name: Wrath
description: Hurl a ball of energy at the target, dealing 229 Nature damage.

name: Ysera's Gift
description: Heals you for 3% of your maximum health every 5 sec. If you are at full health, an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.

name: Call of Ohn'ahra
description: Nature's Swiftness now also affects Cyclone, but its cooldown is increased by 10 sec.

name: Deep Roots
description: Increases the amount of damage required to cancel your Entangling Roots by 75%.

name: Disentanglement
description: Efflorescence removes all snare effects from friendly targets when it heals and its Mana cost is reduced by 40%.

name: Early Spring
description:
Wild Growth is now instant cast, and when you heal 6 allies with Wild Growth you gain Full Bloom. This effect has a 30 sec cooldown.

Full Bloom
Your next Wild Growth applies Lifebloom to all targets at 100% effectiveness. Lasts for 30 sec.

name: Entangling Bark
description: Ironbark now also grants the target Nature's Grasp, rooting the first 3 melee attackers for 6 sec.

name: Forest Guardian
description: Wrath, Starfire, Cyclone, and Combo-Point generating abilities extend the duration of your active heal over time effects by 1.0 sec on up to 3 allies.\n\nStarsurge and Combo-Point spending abilities increase the rate of your heal over time spells by 20% for 4 sec.

name: High Winds
description: Increases the range of Cyclone, Typhoon, and Entangling Roots by 5 yds.

name: Malorne's Swiftness
description: Your Travel Form movement speed while within a Battleground or Arena is increased by 20% and you always move at 100% movement speed while in Travel Form.

name: Thorns
description: Casting Barkskin sprouts thorns on you for 12 sec. When victim to melee attacks, thorns deals 433 Nature damage back to the attacker.\n\nAttackers also have their movement speed reduced by 50% for 4 sec.

name: Tireless Pursuit
description: For 3 sec after leaving Cat Form or Travel Form, you retain up to 25% movement speed.

name: Abundance
description: For each Rejuvenation you have active, Regrowth's cost is reduced by 8% and critical effect chance is increased by 8%, up to a maximum of 96%.

name: Aessina's Renewal
description: When a hit deals more than 12% of your maximum health, instantly heal for 10% of your health.\n\nThis effect cannot occur more than once every 30 seconds.

name: Astral Influence
description: Increases the range of all of your spells by 5 yards.

name: Blooming Infusion
description: Every 5 Regrowths you cast makes your next Wrath, Starfire, or Entangling Roots instant and increases damage it deals by 100%.\n\nEvery 5 Starsurges you cast makes your next Regrowth or Entangling roots instant.

name: Bond with Nature
description: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.

name: Bounteous Bloom
description: Your Grove Guardians' healing is increased by 30%.

name: Bursting Growth
description: When Bloodseeker Vines expire or you use Ferocious Bite on their target they explode in thorns, dealing 30 physical damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.\n\nWhen Symbiotic Blooms expire or you cast Rejuvenation on their target flowers grow around their target, healing them and up to 3 nearby allies for 160.

name: Call of the Elder Druid
description:
When you cast Starsurge, Rake, Shred, or Frenzied Regeneration you gain Call of the Elder Druid for 15 sec, once every 1 min.

 Call of the Elder Druid
Abilities not associated with your specialization are substantially empowered for 45 sec.

Balance: Cast time of Balance spells reduced by 30% and damage increased by 20%.

Feral: Gain 1 Combo Point every 2 sec while in Cat Form and Physical damage increased by 20%.

Guardian: Bear Form gives an additional 20% Stamina, multiple uses of Ironfur may overlap, and Frenzied Regeneration has 2 charges.

Restoration: Healing increased by 30%, and mana costs reduced by 50%.

name: Cenarius' Guidance
description:
Incarnation: Tree of Life
During Incarnation: Tree of Life, you summon a Grove Guardian every 10 sec. The cooldown of Incarnation: Tree of Life is reduced by 5.0 sec when Grove Guardians fade.

 Convoke the Spirits
Convoke the Spirits' cooldown is reduced by 50% and its duration and number of spells cast is reduced by 25%. Convoke the Spirits has an increased chance to use an exceptional spell or ability.

name: Cenarius' Might
description: Swiftmend healing is increased by 20%.

name: Circle of the Heavens
description: Magical damage dealt by your spells increased by 5%.

name: Circle of the Wild
description: Physical damage dealt by your abilities increased by 5%.

name: Control of the Dream
description: Time elapsed while your major abilities are available to be used or at maximum charges is subtracted from that ability's cooldown after the next time you use it, up to 15 seconds.\n\nAffects Force of Nature, Celestial Alignment, and Convoke the Spirits.

name: Cultivation
description: When Rejuvenation heals a target below 60% health, they are instantly healed for 115.

name: Dream Surge
description: When Grove Guardians are summoned, they grow Dream Petals on your target, healing up to 3 nearby allies for 564.

name: Dream of Cenarius
description: Wrath and Shred transfer 100% of their damage and Starfire and Swipe transfer 50% of their damage into healing onto a nearby ally. \n\nThis effect is increased by 200% while Call of the Elder Druid is active.

name: Dryad's Dance
description: Dryads cause most of your Astral power generation to be increased by 10%.

name: Durability of Nature
description: Your Force of Nature treants have 100% increased health.

name: Embrace of the Dream
description: Wild Growth momentarily shifts your mind into the Emerald Dream, instantly healing all allies affected by your Rejuvenation or Regrowth for 820.

name: Entangling Vortex
description: Enemies pulled into Ursol's Vortex are rooted in place for 3 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Everbloom
description: Lifebloom stacks every 5 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Expansiveness
description: Your maximum mana is increased by 5%.

name: Feline Swiftness
description: Increases your movement speed by 15%.

name: Flourish
description: Tranquility extends the duration of all of your heal over time effects by 2 sec every 0.9 sec.

name: Flower Walk
description: During Barkskin your movement speed is increased by 10% and every second flowers grow beneath your feet that heal up to 3 nearby injured allies for 76.

name: Fluid Form
description:
Shred, Rake, and Skull Bash can be used in any form and shift you into Cat Form, if necessary. 

Mangle can be used in any form and shifts you into Bear Form. 

Wrath and Starfire shift you into Moonkin Form, if known.

name: Forestwalk
description: Casting Regrowth increases your movement speed and healing received by 8% for 6 sec.

name: Gale Winds
description: Increases Typhoon's radius by 20% and its range by 5 yds.

name: Germination
description: You can apply Rejuvenation twice to the same target. Rejuvenation's duration is increased by 2 sec.

name: Gift of the Wild
description: Mark of the Wild is 100% more effective on yourself.

name: Green Thumb
description: The rate at which Symbiotic Blooms grow is increased by 20%.

name: Grievous Wounds
description: Rake, Rip, and Thrash damage increased by 10%.

name: Grove Guardians
description: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth summons a Treant that casts Nourish on that target or a nearby ally periodically, healing for 234. Lasts 8 sec.

name: Grove's Inspiration
description: Wrath and Starfire damage increased by 10%. \n\nRegrowth, Wild Growth, and Swiftmend healing increased by 9%.

name: Harmonious Blooming
description: Lifebloom counts for 3 stacks of Mastery: Harmony.

name: Harmonious Constitution
description: Your Regrowth's healing to yourself is increased by 35%.

name: Harmony of the Grove
description: Each of your Grove Guardians increases your healing done by 5% while active.

name: Hunt Beneath the Open Skies
description: Damage and healing while in Cat Form increased by 3%.\n\nMoonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.

name: Implant
description: Casting Swiftmend or Wild Growth causes a Symbiotic Bloom to grow on a target for 6 sec.

name: Improved Barkskin
description: Barkskin's duration is increased by 4 sec.

name: Improved Ironbark
description: Ironbark's cooldown is reduced by 20 sec.

name: Improved Nature's Cure
description: Nature's Cure additionally removes all Curse and Poison effects.

name: Improved Regrowth
description: Regrowth's initial heal has a 40% increased chance for a critical effect if the target is already affected by Regrowth.

name: Improved Stampeding Roar
description: Cooldown reduced by 60 sec.

name: Improved Swiftmend
description: Swiftmend healing increased by 30%.

name: Improved Wild Growth
description: Wild Growth heals 2 additional targets.

name: Incessant Tempest
description: Reduces the cooldown of Typhoon by 5 sec.

name: Inner Peace
description: Reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 30 sec.\n\nWhile channeling Tranquility, you take 20% reduced damage and are immune to knockbacks.

name: Instincts of the Claw
description: Ferocious Bite and Maul damage increased by 8%.

name: Intensity
description: When Regrowth critically heals, it is 260% effective instead of the usual 200%.

name: Killer Instinct
description: Physical damage and Armor increased by 6%.

name: Lethal Preservation
description: When you remove an effect with Soothe or Remove Corruption, gain a combo point and heal for 4% of your maximum health. If you are at full health an injured party or raid member will be healed instead.

name: Lifetreading
description: Efflorescence healing increased by 25%, and it now automatically grows beneath your Lifebloom target's feet.

name: Lingering Healing
description: Rejuvenation's duration is increased by 3 sec.\n\nRegrowth's duration is increased by 3 sec when cast on yourself.

name: Liveliness
description: Your damage over time effects deal their damage 25% faster, and your healing over time effects heal 5% faster.

name: Lore of the Grove
description: Moonfire and Sunfire damage increased by 10%.

name: Lycara's Inspiration
description:
You gain a bonus while in each form inspired by the breadth of your Druidic knowledge:

No Form: 4% Magic Damage
Cat Form: 4% Stamina
Bear Form: 5% Movement Speed
Moonkin Form: 3% Area damage taken reduction

name: Lycara's Teachings
description:
You gain 3% of a stat while in each form:

No Form: Haste
Cat Form: Critical Strike
Bear Form: Versatility
Moonkin Form: Mastery

name: Master Shapeshifter
description:
Your abilities are amplified based on your current shapeshift form, granting an additional effect.

Wrath, Starfire, and Starsurge deal 30% additional damage and generate 324 Mana.

Bear Form
Ironfur grants 30% additional armor and generates 375 Mana.

 Cat Form
Rip, Ferocious Bite, and Maim deal 60% additional damage and generate 1,500 Mana when cast with 5 combo points.

name: Matted Fur
description: When you use Barkskin or Survival Instincts, absorb 525 damage for 15 sec.

name: Natural Recovery
description: Healing you receive is increased by 4%.

name: Nature's Bounty
description: Regrowth heals all other allies with Regrowth for 20% of its healing.

name: Nature's Splendor
description: The healing bonus to Regrowth from Nature's Swiftness is increased by 35%.

name: Nurturing Dormancy
description: When your Rejuvenation heals a full health target, its duration is increased by 2 sec, up to a maximum total increase of 6 sec per cast.

name: Nurturing Instinct
description: Magical damage and healing increased by 6%.

name: Oakskin
description: Survival Instincts and Barkskin reduce damage taken by an additional 10%.

name: Omen of Clarity
description: Your healing over time from Lifebloom has a 4% chance to cause a Clearcasting state, making your next Regrowth cost no mana.

name: Passing Seasons
description: Nature's Swiftness's cooldown is reduced by 12 sec.

name: Patient Custodian
description: Your heal over time effects are 6% more effective.

name: Perfectly-Honed Instincts
description: Well-Honed Instincts can trigger up to once every 90 sec.

name: Photosynthesis
description: Your periodic heals on targets with Lifebloom have a 8% chance to cause it to bloom.

name: Potent Enchantments
description: Orbital Strike damage increased by 30%, and damage of Stellar Flares it applies increased by 30%.\n\nWhirling Stars increases the haste you gain during Celestial Alignment by an additional 10%.

name: Power of Nature
description: Your Grove Guardians increase the healing of your Rejuvenation, Efflorescence, and Lifebloom by 10% while active.

name: Power of the Archdruid
description: Soul of the Forest now causes your next Rejuvenation or Regrowth to apply to 2 additional allies within 20 yards of the target.

name: Power of the Dream
description: Dream Surge heals 1 additional ally.

name: Primal Fury
description: While in Cat Form, when you critically strike with an attack that generates a combo point, you gain an additional combo point. Damage over time cannot trigger this effect.\n\nMangle critical strike damage increased by 20%.

name: Prosperity
description: Swiftmend now has 2 charges.

name: Protective Growth
description: Your Regrowth protects you, reducing damage you take by 8% while your Regrowth is on you.

name: Rampancy
description: Symbiotic Blooms have a 20% chance to trigger Bursting Growth every 2 sec at 100% effectiveness.

name: Rampant Growth
description: Regrowth's healing over time is increased by 100%, and it also applies to the target of your Lifebloom.

name: Reforestation
description: Every 4 casts of Swiftmend grants you Incarnation: Tree of Life for 10 sec.

name: Regenerative Heartwood
description: Allies protected by your Ironbark also receive 75% of the healing from each of your active Rejuvenations and Ironbark's duration is increased by 4 sec.

name: Regenesis
description: Rejuvenation healing is increased by up to 10%, and Tranquility healing is increased by up to 20%, healing for more on low-health targets.

name: Renewing Surge
description: Swiftmend cooldown is reduced by 15%, increasing up to 30% on lower health targets.

name: Resilient Flourishing
description: Bloodseeker Vines and Symbiotic Blooms last 2 additional sec.\n\nWhen a target afflicted by Bloodseeker Vines dies, the vines jump to a valid nearby target for their remaining duration.

name: Root Network
description: Each active Bloodseeker Vine increases the damage your abilities deal by 2%.\n\nEach active Symbiotic Bloom increases the healing of your spells by 2%.

name: Soul of the Forest
description: Swiftmend increases the healing of your next Regrowth or Rejuvenation by 60%.

name: Spirit of the Thicket
description: Your Starfall damage is increased by 12% and your Starsurge damage is increased by 8%.

name: Starlight Conduit
description: Wrath, Starsurge, and Starfire damage increased by 5%. \n\nStarsurge's cooldown is reduced by 4 sec and its mana cost is reduced by 50%.

name: Stonebark
description: Ironbark increases healing from your heal over time effects by 20%.

name: Strategic Infusion
description: Attacking from Prowl increases the chance for Shred, Rake, and Swipe to critically strike by 8% for 6 sec.\n\nYour periodic heals have a 4% increased chance to critically heal.

name: Sylvan Beckoning
description: Entering an Eclipse summons a Dryad to assist you for 8 sec, casting Starsurge dealing 572 Astral damage and Starfall at 200% effectiveness.

name: Thick Hide
description: Reduces all damage taken by 4%.

name: Thriving Growth
description:
Rip and Rake damage has a chance to cause Bloodseeker Vines to grow on the victim, dealing 34 Bleed damage over 6 sec.

Wild Growth, Regrowth, and Efflorescence healing has a chance to cause Symbiotic Blooms to grow on the target, healing for 834 over 6 sec.

Multiple instances of these can overlap.

name: Thriving Vegetation
description: Rejuvenation instantly heals your target for 20% of its total periodic effect and Regrowth's duration is increased by 3 sec.

name: Tranquil Mind
description: Increases Omen of Clarity's chance to activate Clearcasting to 5% and Clearcasting can stack 1 additional time.

name: Treants of the Moon
description: Your Grove Guardians cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.

name: Twin Sprouts
description: When Bloodseeker Vines or Symbiotic Blooms grow, they have a 30% chance to cause another growth of the same type to immediately grow on a valid nearby target.

name: Unstoppable Growth
description: Wild Growth's healing falls off 40% less over time.

name: Ursine Vigor
description: For 4 sec after shifting into Bear Form, your health and armor are increased by 15%.

name: Ursoc's Spirit
description: Stamina increased by 4%.\n\nStamina in Bear Form is increased by an additional 5%.

name: Verdancy
description: When Lifebloom blooms, up to 3 targets within your Efflorescence are healed for 360.

name: Verdant Heart
description: Frenzied Regeneration and Barkskin increase all healing received by 20%.

name: Verdant Infusion
description: Swiftmend no longer consumes a heal over time effect, and extends the duration of your heal over time effects on the target by 8 sec.

name: Vigorous Creepers
description: Bloodseeker Vines increase the damage your abilities deal to affected enemies by 4%.\n\nSymbiotic Blooms increase the healing your spells do to affected targets by 20%.

name: Waking Dream
description: Ysera's Gift now heals every 4 sec and its healing is increased by 8% for each of your active Rejuvenations.

name: Well-Honed Instincts
description: When you fall below 40% health, you cast Frenzied Regeneration, up to once every 120 sec.

name: Wild Synthesis
description: Grove Guardians, Efflorescence, and your other summons heal for 30% more.

name: Wildstalker's Power
description: Rip and Ferocious Bite damage increased by 5%.\n\nRejuvenation healing increased by 10%.

name: Incarnation
description: Activates a superior shapeshifting form appropriate to your specialization for $d.  You may freely shapeshift in and out of this form for its duration.
